entries.title: Keywords: split Deathtouch / Venomous / Poisonous (+ Poisoned condition)
entries.body:
They were all the same instant-kill. Now distinct:
- Deathtouch: any damage it deals to a creature destroys it (persistent).
- Venomous: same, but one-shot — spent after the first kill (like Divine Shield),
  and removed from the creature.
- Poisonous: doesn't kill outright — it applies the Poisoned condition.
- Poisoned: at the end of its controller's turn the creature takes 2 damage;
  persists until cleansed or dead.

The old `poisoned` flag (which actually meant "marked for death") is renamed to
`doomed`; `poisoned` now means the real condition. Added KW.VENOMOUS, the
end-of-turn poison tick, split the keyword glossary into four entries, and
taught the AI that Venomous (not Poisonous) counts as a kill.

Verified in-engine: 1-attack deathtouch/venomous each kill a 10-HP wall;
venomous is consumed after; poisonous leaves the wall alive+poisoned; the poison
deals 2 at the end of the controller's turn.

entries.title: Decks: optional commander + companion (40 + 1 + 1 = 42)
entries.body:
Each deck may bring one commander and one companion — both optional, each in its
own zone alongside the 40-card deck, so the true max is 42.

- Engine: createGame takes a per-player `loadouts` arg; when supplied it uses the
  chosen commander/companion (or none), otherwise it keeps the legacy random
  deal for single-player/dungeon. Verified both paths.
- Deckbuilder: COMMANDER / COMPANION slots under the deck name open a picker of
  the class's commander/companion cards (rendered faces); equip/remove updates
  the count to "40 / 40 (+2 = 42)". Stored on the deck slot; validated (right
  kind + class) client- and server-side.
- MP: challenge party, accept-challenge match config, and the duel boot all
  carry hostCommander/hostCompanion + guestCommander/guestCompanion; mp.mjs
  validates via new loadout-cards.json and stores them on the slot.

Verified: engine uses chosen loadout (p0) and empty for a deck with none (p1);
deckbuilder equips Sheriff Goldie + Dusty the Coyote, count shows +2 = 42, save
persists both. Live two-client duel with loadouts still needs a realm test.

entries.title: Deckbuilder: drag cards to add, tap/click opens the card page
entries.body:
- Tap/click a card opens its detail page (big face, type line, rules with
  keyword explanations, owned count) with an + Add to Deck button and Close.
- Building is now drag-driven: on desktop, drag a card onto the deck panel to
  add it (HTML5 DnD, panel highlights on hover); on touch, long-press a card
  and drag it onto the deck panel / DECK button (a ghost follows your finger,
  short moves still scroll the grid). Adding switches the panel to the deck
  editor so you see the card land.
- The + Add to Deck button on the card page is the easy add path on mobile.

Verified headless (mouse mode): tiles are draggable; click opens the page;
Add-to-Deck grows the deck and updates the owned line; a drop on the deck panel
adds the card and reveals the editor. 0 errors.

entries.title: Deckbuilder: default to first class alphabetically on open / New Deck
entries.body:
The class dropdown is sorted A→Z and the first class (Barbarian) is selected by
default. Opening the builder and hitting New Deck both land on the blank
starting page with that class already selected and its cards showing, instead
of the "pick a class" prompt. Boot waits for both classes.json and cards.json
before initializing so firstClass is always known.

Verified headless: boot + New Deck select Barbarian with cards shown, empty
deck, no prompt; 0 errors.

entries.title: Deck banners: hero art backdrops from the OCR class cards
entries.body:
Cropped the art window from the 16 class "hero" cards in the paper OCR set
(all_cards.json type_line "Class" → source PNGs) into art/hero_<classId>.jpg and
registered them in art/index.json. Deck banners in MY DECKS now use the class
hero art as the background (darkened on the left so the deck name stays legible),
falling back to the flat class colour for any class without hero art.

Verified: banners render mage/warlock/hunter hero art with readable names and
N/40 counts; 0 errors.

entries.title: Deckbuilder: Hearthstone-style My Decks panel + card owned-pills
entries.body:
- Right panel is now a two-mode "My Decks" view: a scrollable list of
  class-colored deck banners (name + N/40 count, green when complete, gold when
  partial, active deck highlighted), with the + Create New Deck button at the
  BOTTOM of the deck scroll. Selecting a deck (or creating one) switches to an
  edit view with a ← My Decks back button, deck name, card list, save/delete.
- Collection cards show a Hearthstone-style owned pill under each card
  ("×2", or "1 left · ×2" as copies go into the deck); depleted cards dim.
- Boot opens on the My Decks list; deleting a deck returns there.

Verified headless: boot shows the list with Create at the bottom of the scroll;
create → edit view; save a 40-card deck → banner shows "40/40" green with the
class color; back returns to the list. 0 errors. Screenshot matches the HS
collection-manager layout.

entries.title: Deckbuilder redesign: real card faces, Class/Neutral tabs, mobile-first
entries.body:
Rebuilt the collection view on the gallery's renderer instead of text rows:
- Real rendered card faces (drawCardFace) in a responsive grid, paginated with
  preloadArt so art streams in cleanly; art-load repaints the page.
- Hearthstone-style CLASS / NEUTRAL tabs that split the pool for the chosen
  class, plus a mana-cost filter row (0–7+) and a search box.
- Tap a card to add (owned/in-deck badges, depleted dimming); tap a deck row to
  remove. Cheap per-tile count updates, no full re-render on each add.
- Mobile-first: single-column grid and the deck becomes a slide-up panel behind
  a DECK n/40 toggle; dropped the heavy 3D preview entirely.
- Slot logic (MY DECKS up to 40, new/edit/delete/name, save) carried over.

Fix: the Delete button had CSS display:none, so setting inline display='' fell
back to none and it never showed — now sets 'block'.

Verified headless: class prompt → pick class → real canvas tiles in both tabs,
mana filter + pager + search, tap-to-add with badge, save a full 40 into a slot,
delete button visible, mobile toggle opens the deck panel. 0 errors.

entries.title: Decks: 40 deck slots, Mage Starter seed, delete + empty-state
entries.body:
Deck storage moves from one-per-class to a list of up to 40 named PvP deck
slots (user.decks: [{id,name,classId,cards}]).

Backend (mp.mjs):
- normalizeDecks() migrates the old per-class object to slots one-time; legacy
  10-card starter decks are dropped, and if that leaves none you get a 40-card
  Mage Starter. New accounts start with the Mage Starter too. So both test
  accounts get a ready mage deck and can skip building.
- save-deck creates/updates a slot by id (cap 40, "slots full" past that);
  delete-deck removes one. reset-deck removed. Mage Starter validated against
  the real pool (exactly 40, mage/neutral, within copy caps).

Client:
- Deck builder is now slot-based: MY DECKS list (up to 40), ＋ New Deck, per-deck
  name, Save (create/update), Delete This Deck. Class stays the first choice.
  Free-play stores slots in localStorage (migrating the old single deck).
- Overworld card battle reads the slot array; with no valid 40-card deck it
  shows "You have no decks :(" and blocks the battle (both challenger and
  accepter). Deck-select labels show the deck name.

Verified: slot lifecycle headless (build→save→new→edit→delete, 0 errors);
backend slot/migration/cap/delete logic unit-tested against pool-rarity.json;
overworld boots clean.

entries.title: Decks: 40-card class-based PvP constructed + class-first builder
entries.body:
Constructed/PvP decks are now 40 cards (was 30 free-play / 10 MP). Players
build their own from their collection; DECK_SIZE=40 in collection.js and the
MP backend (mp.mjs) validates 40. Overworld card-battle deck selection
(openDeckSelect + cardParty) now requires a full 40-card deck.

Dungeon runs are fully separated: dungeonStarterDeck() always uses the stock
10-card Dungeon.STARTER_DECKS and never reads the account's PvP decks, so a
dungeon deck can't leak into PvP and vice-versa.

Deckbuilder polish — class is the FIRST choice:
- No "all cards" option; you pick a class before anything shows.
- With no class the collection is a prompt ("choose your class"); picking one
  filters to neutral + that class (+ duals) and loads any deck saved for it.
- Switching class prunes off-class cards from the working deck.
- Count reads "/ 40"; save/auto-fill require a class; MP save stores a 40-card
  PvP deck per class ("take it into card battles").

Verified headless: builder boots to a class prompt at 0/40, picking Mage
filters the grid, no errors; overworld still boots clean.

entries.title: Rules: MTG hand-size cleanup + tokens exile on death
entries.body:
Hand size (MAX_HAND 15): drawing/gaining a card past 15 no longer burns it.
The hand may exceed 15 during your turn; at end of turn you discard down to 15,
MTG-style — YOUR choice which cards (human via the discard modal, AI dumps its
priciest). Replaces the old auto-pop-newest trim. Removed the burn-on-overdraw
in drawCards/addCardToHand/addCoin and the silent < MAX_HAND drops on
return-to-hand / copy-spell / conjure effects.

Tokens: instantiate() now carries the token flag, and every summoned token
(inline opt-summons included) is marked token:true. toGraveyard exiles any
token — summoned creatures, Blood/Clue/Food/Treasure — instead of sending it to
the graveyard, so tokens leave no corpse and can't be reanimated, referenced,
or reshuffled. Coins are NOT tokens and still go to the graveyard (reshuffle).

Verified in-engine: overdraw to 29 with no burn; end-of-turn queues a 14-card
choose-your-discard down to 15; deck-out reshuffles the graveyard (tokens
excluded); a summoned token dies to exile, not the graveyard.

entries.title: Gibberling snowballs properly
entries.body:
Add summonId support to the summon effect: instantiate a real card def so the
summoned token keeps its own ongoing. Gibberling's Spellburst now summons a
real Gibberling (with Spellburst), so each spell grows the board (1->2->3->4,
verified) instead of making an inert 1/1.

entries.title: import 12 Scholomance Academy cards (+ Cub token)
entries.body:
New cards (none already in pool), with wiki art:
- Ras Frostwhisper, Cram Session, Brain Freeze (Combo), Molten Blast,
  Boneweb Egg, Survival of the Fittest (buff-zones), Onyx Magescribe
  (Spellburst), Adorable Infestation, Manafeeder Panthara, Groundskeeper,
  Diligent Notetaker (Spellburst), Gibberling.

Small engine additions: conditional predicates heroPowerUsed +
holdingSpellMinCost; a return-played-spell effect in runSecretEffects (for
Spellburst "return the spell"). Spellburst reuses the once-per spell-played
ongoing; buff-zones/combo already existed.

Verified live: end-of-turn AoE, Combo (freeze+3), buff-zones (board & hand
+4/+4), heroPowerUsed & holdingSpellMinCost conditionals both directions,
Spellburst conjure, and Notetaker returning the real cast spell. Gibberling
summons a plain 1/1 (inline summon can't carry its own Spellburst, so it
doesn't infinitely snowball).

entries.title: EVH import batch 2 — 5 cards, faithfully wired
entries.body:
Add (with wiki art + 3 small engine additions):
- Ball and Chain (1 warrior weapon): Deathrattle buff your DAMAGED minions
  +1/+2 (new buff requireDamaged filter).
- Widow's Bite (2 druid): hero +1 Atk this turn, +1 Armor, add Widow's Feast
  -> Widow's Banquet chain (two new token spells).
- Bone Flurry (2 DK): 3 dmg split among enemies; if a friendly minion died
  this turn, 3 more (new conditional friendlyDied).
- Crowd Control (3 warrior): 2 dmg to all minions; +2 more if deck >= 25 (new
  conditional deckAtLeast).
- Getaway Hogdriver (5 neutral Quilboar): Battlecry draw 2; if both minions,
  gain Charge (new draw-check effect).

Verified live: buff hits only damaged, deck>=25 doubles, both-minions grants
Charge, Widow's Feast is added. Skipped Disguised Watchman (Disguise) and
Molten Gold (cast-3-spells transform) — both need bespoke mechanics.

entries.title: EVH import batch 1 — IMPFERNAL! + fix two stubs
entries.body:
- Add IMPFERNAL! (6-mana 6/6 neutral epic Demon; Deathrattle: 3 damage to all
  other characters) with wiki art.
- Fix Specter of Despair: its Taunt/"Can't attack" were text-only (it could

- Fix Arachnathid: Rush + "friendly minions Poisonous" were text-only ->

Lotus Bookie and Sewer Imp were already wired correctly.

entries.title: add Concealing Confection (neutral common Mech)
entries.body:
1-mana 1/2 Mech: Deathrattle - get a random weapon (conjure-random weapon).
Art from the supplied Concealing_Confection_full.jpg.

entries.title: consolidate to one Colaque's Shell
entries.body:
Remove the stray collectible duplicate (colaque_s_shell) — nothing summoned
or referenced it. Keep token_colaques_shell, the actual appendage Colaque

entries.body: 22 cards folded into the existing Mech tribe.

Tag the collectible colaque_s_shell creature with colossalOf: Colaque so it

entries.title: Mica, Wanderknight - line break before Spell Damage
Idol of Y'Shaarj is a 10/10 creature (Battlecry summons a 10/10)
entries.body:
Was an 8-mana sorcery; now a 10/10 Priest creature whose Battlecry summons a
10/10 Idol of Y'Shaarj token. The token (token_idol_of_y_shaarj) gets a copy
of the idol's art so it looks identical; it has no battlecry, so no loop.

entries.title: drop the "Static:" prefix on planes
entries.body: The persistent effect line stands on its own between Arrival and Chaos.

entries.title: add 8 Planechase-style planes + 3 plane static mechanisms
entries.body:
New planes (Arrival/Static/Chaos/Departure), adapted from MTG planes into the
game's idiom:
- Krosa (all creatures +2/+2), Sokenzan (all +1/+1 & Rush), The Hippodrome
  (all -5 Attack) -> new plane "aura" staticRule wired into recomputeAuras.
- Stronghold Furnace (combat damage doubled) -> new "double-damage" rule in
  resolveCombat.
- Lethe Lake (turn-start mill), Takenuma (creature dies -> owner draws),
  Fields of Summer (cast -> gain life), Minamo (cast -> draw) -> general
  plane "trigger" staticRule fired at turn-start / sweepDeaths / spell-cast.
drawCards already handled; effects reuse existing types (draw/mill/heal/
damage/summon/destroy-random/bounce).

keywords.js: scope the plane vocabulary (Arrival/Chaos/Departure/Static) so a
plane's "Static:" shows the plane meaning while the combat Static keyword
still reads as paralyze on creatures.

Verified live: auras (5/5, 0/3, 4/4+Rush), doubled combat (6), death-draw,
cast-draw, cast-life, turn-start mill — all correct, 0 errors. Planes bucket
now lists 14.

entries.title: Backstab is a Rogue card (was bounty_hunter)
Ancient Watcher - Defender & Pacifist on line 1, Inspire below
Ancient Watcher uses the Pacifist keyword
entries.body:
Its "Can't Attack" was text-only (never enforced). Add the pacifist keyword
(engine already blocks attacks for it) and reword the card to "Pacifist."

entries.title: rename Savannah Lions -> Godsbreath Tyrant + Beast tribe
entries.body: Kept the id (savannah_lions) so any art reference stays intact.

entries.title: Coin & Banana are non-collectible but not tokens (reshuffle)
entries.body:
They were flagged token:true, which both hid them AND made them cease to
exist on deck reshuffle. Split those concerns:
- Coin & Banana: drop token, add collectible:false.
- All pool/collection/discover/generation filters now also exclude
  collectible:false (so they stay out of decks, the collectible pool, random
  generation, and are hidden in the gallery — unchanged behavior).
- The graveyard-reshuffle filter keys on token only, so Coin & Banana now
  reshuffle back into the deck; true tokens (Blood/Clue/Food/Treasure) still
  cease to exist. viewer isUncollectible + cardart honor collectible:false.

Verified: Coin/Banana reshuffle; Blood Token does not; they stay in Generic
and never appear under a collectible class.

entries.title: Treasure Token -> Token tribe; Coin & Banana -> Generic
entries.body:
- Treasure Token gets tribe "Token" (so it joins Generic and exiles instead
  of graveyarding, like Blood/Clue/Food).
- The Coin and Banana bucket into uncollectible Generic by id (kept as plain
  neutral token spells — no tribe/exile change). Generic is now 21.

entries.title: Token tribe -> Generic + exile-instead-of-graveyard
entries.body:
- Tag Blood Token, Clue Token, Food Token with tribe "Token".
- systemBucket buckets any Token-tribe card into uncollectible Generic
  (gallery + viewer), so those three move out of their class into Generic.
- toGraveyard now exiles Token-tribe cards instead of adding them to the
  graveyard (no corpse, unreanimatable). Verified in a live game: a Token
  creature dying lands in exile; a normal creature still goes to graveyard.

entries.title: optional draws — `may` prompt + draw-success gating
entries.body:
Add a reusable optional-decision mechanism so "you may …" effects actually
prompt and can be declined, and gate follow-ups on a real draw:
- drawCards() now returns the number of cards that reached hand.
- new effect `draw-then`: draw N, run `then` only if a card was drawn.
- new effect `may` + state.askQueue + resolveAsk(): defers a yes/no to the
  controller; AI auto-takes it (resolveAIAsks), the human gets a centered
  Draw/Pass popup (openAskModal, reusing the choose-one decision menu), with
  multiplayer guest relay (k:'ask').
- Arcane Artisan now uses may -> draw-then -> damage, so you may draw, and
  each opponent loses 1 Life only if you actually drew.

Verified in a live game: casting an Arcane spell (with an artifact) prompts;
Draw -> deck -1 and opponent -1; Pass -> no change; nothing happens until the
choice is made.

entries.title: add Arcane Artisan (sorcerer rare) + conditional trigger support
entries.body:
3-mana 3/3 Human Wizard: if you control an artifact or enchantment, whenever
you cast an Arcane spell, draw a card and each opponent loses 1 Life.

Wired as a spell-played ongoing gated by two new ongoingCondOk checks:
- cond.school: the played spell's school (schoolOf) must match (Arcane)
- cond.controlArtEnch: caster must control an artifact or enchantment
Both are additive and unused elsewhere, so no regression. Verified in a live
game: fires only with an artifact + Arcane spell (draw + opponent -1 Life),
gated off otherwise. Art cropped from the supplied card image.

entries.title: add Furious Lutrin (barbarian common)
entries.body:
3-mana 2/2 Beast. Alliance (creature-played -> buff-self +1/+1) via ongoings,
Frenzy (self-damaged, once/survives -> draw 2) via ongoing so the damage
handler fires it exactly once. Art cropped from the supplied card image.

entries.title: reorder Triumphant Troubadour tribes to Angel Barbarian Bard
put Swing / Frenzy abilities on their own lines
entries.body:
- Gogogo Goram: Swing ability on its own line below Trample & Magnetic.
- Triumphant Troubadour: Frenzy on its own line, separate from Lifesteal.

entries.title: add Odd Minstrel (neutral epic collectible)
entries.body:
3-mana 2/4 neutral Human Bard: Divine Shield & Elusive; Deathrattle adds a
coin to each player's hand (gain-coin + give-enemy-card). Art cropped from
the supplied card image into art/odd_minstrel.jpg + indexed.

entries.title: excavate spells have no spell school
entries.body:
Remove the "Fel" spell school (tribe) from Azerite Fragment, Fool's Azerite,
Azerite Chunk, and Azerite Gem. They stay plain sorceries with no school.

entries.title: flag the 4 excavate dig spells into Excavate
entries.body:
Mark Azerite Fragment, Fool's Azerite, Azerite Chunk, and Azerite Gem with
excavate:true so they join the Excavate section (25 total). They keep their
rarities (uncommon/common/rare/epic) via the existing showsRarity rule.

entries.title: Battlecards/wiki: new Excavate uncollectible section (keeps rarity)
entries.body:
- Mark the 21 Azerite class legendaries with excavate:true.
- Add an "Excavate" bucket to the gallery/viewer uncollectible group, keyed
  off the excavate flag (checked first in systemBucket so these come out of
  their class sections).
- Unlike other uncollectible cards, excavate cards keep their rarity: add
  showsRarity(card) (collectible OR excavate) and use it for the rarity gem
  on the face and the "· Rarity" text in the wiki meta + viewer type-line.
